rules.statement: A person in whose favour a deed of agreement for sale of land was executed by its owner is not by the mere registration of such deed in a position to enforce specific performance against a third party, to whom the land was sold subsequent to such registration.
rules.supporting_quote: "A person in whose favour a deed of agreement for sale of a land was executed by its owner is not by the mere registration of such deed in a position to enforce specific performance against a third party, to whom the land was sold subsequent to such registration."
